verdict.rationale: Front-door reachability is a fair question for a government filing and guidance site, so the axis applies. Probes found bot walls instead: Akamai returned 403 "Access Denied" at www.nvsos.gov/robots.txt, a same-day follow-up got an Imperva Incapsula bot-challenge interstitial, and the ORION filing portal served an Incapsula noindex shell. A keyless agent with a standard user agent cannot reach the public reading surface.
